params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The page node (or page chain) whose image the text is drawn onto. Without one the node produces nothing.

params.name: text
params.label: Text
params.description: The text to draw. It is not wrapped: a long line runs past the page edge rather than breaking.

params.name: font
params.label: Font
params.description: Font family name, such as a system font installed on this machine. Empty uses the default font.

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.description: Font size in the page's Units. The same size prints the same at any Resolution; only the pixel count changes.

params.name: color
params.label: Color
params.description: Colour of the text, drawn fully opaque over the page.

params.name: x
params.label: X
params.description: Horizontal position of the text's anchor, in the page's Units from the left edge. Horizontal decides which part of the text sits here.

params.name: y
params.label: Y
params.description: Vertical position of the text's anchor, in the page's Units from the top edge (y runs down). Vertical decides which part of the text sits here.

params.name: horizontal
params.label: Horizontal
params.description: Which part of the text is placed at X: its left edge, its centre, or its right edge.

params.name: vertical
params.label: Vertical
params.description: Which part of the text block is placed at Y: its top, its middle, or its bottom.

params.name: leading
params.label: Leading
params.description: Line spacing as a multiple of Size. 1 sets lines tightly; larger values space multi-line text further apart.
